scope: The Android-side contract for turning a pairing envelope (v2 or v3) into ONE usable, verified connection — or ONE typed failure. Implemented by the pairing client at CP-005 (EndpointResolver + TransportClassifier in the B lane).

binding_rules.text: PARSE ALL CANDIDATES — every endpoint_candidates entry from the envelope, plus the v2 single endpoint (treated as one candidate of its transport class), plus Owner-configured manual alternates; nothing is hardcoded.

REJECT EXPIRED OR MALFORMED CANDIDATES — candidate-level expiry check against the device clock (skew tolerance 300 s), URL syntax check, transport_class membership check; malformed candidates are recorded as evidence, never attempted.

DETECT CURRENT NETWORK TYPE — ConnectivityManager: WIFI / CELLULAR / VPN / NONE; a VPN-on-cellular context still cannot reach LAN_SAME_SUBNET candidates unless the tailnet carries them (TAILSCALE_MAGICDNS class).

AVOID LAN-ONLY ENDPOINTS ON CELLULAR — LAN_MDNS and LAN_IP (network_requirement=LAN_SAME_SUBNET) are SKIPPED (not failed) on CELLULAR with evidence recorded; the UI says why: 'endpoint LAN disponibile solo sulla rete di casa'.

ATTEMPT ONLY QUALIFIED CANDIDATES — ordered by priority; per-candidate bounded attempt: connect timeout 10 s, read timeout 20 s, ONE attempt per candidate per resolution round (one bounded retry round allowed after a 2 s backoff, max 2 rounds total).
ENFORCE BOUNDED TIMEOUT AND RETRY — global resolution budget 45 s; exceeding it ends the round with the last per-candidate typed failure (never hangs, never infinite retry).

RECORD CANDIDATE-BY-CANDIDATE EVIDENCE — for every candidate: transport_class, url (host only in exports), attempted/eligible/skipped reason, typed transport class result (the catalog), latency, TLS verification result, HTTP status; all of it feeds Diagnostics and the secret-clean export.

NEVER WEAKEN TLS SILENTLY — CA validation always on for CA_VALIDATED/TAILSCALE_LE classes; LAN_SELF_SIGNED_EXPECTED candidates fail closed with TLS_CA_UNTRUSTED unless the Owner enabled the EXPLICIT development trust path (which is visually flagged, stored as a setting, and can never ship as production trust).

EXPOSE MANUAL FALLBACK — MANUAL_ADVANCED is always reachable in the pairing UI (advanced sheet): the Owner may enter an endpoint by hand; manual entries pass the SAME validation and classification (no bypass).

RETURN A TYPED FAILURE IF NONE IS USABLE — EndpointResolutionResult.Selected(candidate, evidence) or EndpointResolutionResult.Failed(primaryTypedCode, evidence); 'null' is never an operational result.

outcome_types: SELECTED(candidate) — one verified candidate (TCP+TLS+HTTP contract shape ok) proceeds to claim
SELECTED_UNVERIFIED_HTTP_ONLY — TCP+TLS ok, HTTP contract shape unrecognized: proceed with envelope adapter ON and record the divergence (never bypass)

FAILED(primaryCode) — every eligible candidate exhausted or all skipped (e.g. cellular + LAN-only envelope): the primary code is the most severe class observed; the Owner sees the per-candidate explanation + manual fallback + retry

network_classification_matrix.LAN_MDNS: ELIGIBLE (NSD-resolvable services; .local hostname still not socket-resolvable — LAN_IP candidate or NSD-resolved address used)

network_classification_matrix.TAILSCALE_MAGICDNS: ELIGIBLE only when a Tailscale VPN is ACTIVE

network_classification_matrix.LAN_IP: ELIGIBLE only if subnet route advertises the LAN

network_classification_matrix.all: SKIP — typed failure OFFLINE_NO_NETWORK before any candidate attempt
